sources.notes: Dataset release 2025, created 2026-03-13; source surveys and imagery span multiple years. The same source archive supplies buildings, roads and DEM terrain. One common orthometric datum preserves building/terrain elevations. All 176 selected source roads have height 0.0, treated as missing: road vertices are draped to the DEM with a +0.02 m display offset; triangulated polygon interiors are approximate, not TIN-clipped. the modern underlay does not represent one current-city epoch and is not 1976 evidence.

source_temporality.note: Release year, feature creation date and survey year are distinct. Per-feature survey years are retained; an unknown year is null.
